description: Defines the 'rb_allocation' class for managing frequency resource block allocations in 5G NR, including creation, comparison, validation, and mask generation methods, with custom formatting support.

classes.name: rb_allocation
classes.description: Manages frequency resource block allocations, supporting creation, comparison, validation, and mask generation for 5G NR resource scheduling.

methods.name: make_type0
methods.description: Creates a Type 0 resource block allocation based on a VRB bitmap and optional VRB-to-PRB configuration.

methods.name: make_type1
methods.description: Creates a Type 1 resource block allocation starting from a specified VRB start index with a given count and optional configuration.

methods.name: make_custom
methods.description: Creates a custom resource block allocation from a list of VRB indexes and optional configuration.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Compares two rb_allocation objects for equality based on VRB mask and VRB-to-PRB configuration.

methods.name: is_contiguous
methods.description: Checks if the VRB-to-PRB allocation is contiguous in frequency domain.

methods.name: is_vrb_mask_contiguous
methods.description: Checks if the VRB mask is contiguous.

methods.name: get_nof_rb
methods.description: Returns the number of allocated VRBs.

methods.name: is_bwp_valid
methods.description: Validates if the resource block allocation is compatible with given bandwidth part parameters.

methods.name: get_crb_mask
methods.description: Generates the CRB allocation mask considering BWP parameters and VRB-to-PRB mapping.

methods.name: get_crb_indices
methods.description: Returns sequential CRB indices for the frequency domain allocation.
